reasoning: The two patches address distinct parts of the answer-format guidance, so both are retained without overlap. One clarifies that established canonical labels may have a grammatical form that differs from the referent’s number; the other adds an exception for fixed multiword labels when the whole label is requested. Each edit is supported by one of the two source patches.

edits.target: For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles.
edits.content: For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples. Use the conventional canonical headword or name form supported by the directly relevant clue or source, including established plural-form labels even when referring to one instrument or category; do not mechanically singularize or pluralize for agreement. Include an article only when grammatically required.

edits.target: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component; do not repeat information already given in the clue or add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
edits.content: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component when that is the requested answer. If the blank is embedded in a fixed multiword label and the requested referent is the label as a whole, return its complete conventional form rather than mechanically omitting the part already shown. Do not add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
